no stable oracle headroom over uniform GDumb; learned priority harmful; do not learn priority unless a NEW substrate-specific oracle-headroom gate passes
valid null beyond nearest similarity; nearest similarity is a required control; no learned retriever by default
raw uncertainty fails reducibility discrimination; uncertainty is diagnostic only, not a plasticity controller
source-specific positive, cross-source null; novelty is diagnostic only
learned model planning worse than random; oracle error-aware lacks headroom; no learned simulation allocator; direct prediction/simple planning are controls
not beyond simple change detection; use simple change detectors as baselines
not beyond EMA smoothing; EMA/direct-state are baselines
predictability is not causal message value; centralized matched-capacity is the control
contradiction detection is not repair necessity
no principal headroom or architecture decision on two seeds; >=5 stable seeds plus valid independent units; no opportunistic seed addition after a near miss

rule: do not populate the substrate with failed modules for architectural completeness; failed mechanisms appear only as frozen controls
